_comment: NEGATIVE FIXTURE N04 — receipt emitted before the proof gate. The agent-proof-lifecycle route declares the strict order collect_evidence -> verify_evidence -> emit_receipt (the receipt may only be sealed AFTER verification). This trace emits the receipt before verifying, violating the precedence edge (verify_evidence, emit_receipt). The trace is not a linear extension of the route POWL partial order => off-language => RouteConformanceGap (a receipt-before-gate is the canonical proof-lifecycle defect). Minimal counterexample: swap emit_receipt and verify_evidence back into order.
